title: IT Sales Executive
description:
IT Sales Executive
Salary: £30,000 basic + £5,000 commission (OTE £35,000)
Hours: Full-time
Location: Warwick / Remote office attendance approximately once a month, with travel to clients as required
We re looking for an IT Sales Executive to join a growing business within the technology sector. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who already understands the IT channel or distribution environment and is ready to take the next step into a sales-focused role.
You don t necessarily need to come from a direct sales background. What matters is that you re commercially minded, confident building relationships and excited by the opportunity to develop your career within technology sales.
You ll receive plenty of hands-on support and training while building relationships with partners, generating new opportunities and developing your knowledge of channel sales.
About the candidate
You ll be a self-motivated and proactive individual who is comfortable taking the initiative and creating new opportunities. You ll have a genuine interest in technology, along with the confidence to build strong relationships and communicate effectively with a range of stakeholders.
Ideally, you ll have some experience within IT distribution, the technology channel or a similar environment and be looking to take the next step into a sales-focused position. You ll be commercially minded, organised and comfortable working towards targets, with a proactive approach to identifying and developing new business opportunities.
You ll also be confident using CRM systems and other sales or business tools to manage opportunities and keep track of your pipeline. Previous sales experience would be beneficial but isn t essential, as training and support will be provided.
What you ll do
You ll be responsible for developing relationships with partners, identifying new business opportunities and supporting opportunities throughout the sales process.
You ll identify and approach potential partners, generate new pipeline and help develop new commercial opportunities. Building strong relationships will be a key part of the role, alongside supporting new partners and helping progress opportunities through to completion.
You ll manage your pipeline against agreed targets and KPIs, provide regular forecasts and updates, and support events and partner-focused activities designed to generate engagement and new business.
Benefit
- Predominantly remote working
- Hands-on training and development
- Opportunity to build a career within technology sales
- Exposure to partner and supplier relationship management
- Excellent opportunity to develop channel sales and business development experience

Ready to turn your IT experience into a career in sales? If you re ambitious, commercially minded and ready for your next opportunity, we d love to hear from you apply today!

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Are you an experienced Sales Advisor, with a stong background in New Build Housing?

Approach Personnel are proud to be partnered with a privately owned, regional 5 developer who are currently on the look out for a Sales Advisor to join them on a permanent basis out of their site in Rugby. As a New Build Housing Sales Advisor, you will be responsible for playing a crucial role in the commercial success of our developments, by hitting your sales targets on a quarterly basis, ensuring compliance and standards are upheld through the entirety of the sales process.

What's in it for you?
- Competitive basic salary of 38,000 + OTE
- Continued personal development opportunities
- Private medical care
- Generous annual leave entitlement + bank holidays

What are we looking for?
- Prior, proven experience of working in sales for a new build housing developer.
- Impecable communication skills with both clients and customer experience.
- Commercially astute with a good understanding of the market and competitors
- Full UK's driving licence

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage the sales activities for allocated developments, including lead management, customer appointments, reservations, sales transactions, legal completions and the sale of finishing touches, to ensure achievement of sales targets.
- Update and maintain the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to log the customer journey and facilitate timely and accurate management information.
- Work cohesively with other departments across the Operating Company such as Construction, Commercial and Legal to ensure achievement of completion targets and timely updates relating to plot progress.
- Comply with the Group Health, Safety and Environment Policy and ensure compliance of prospective buyers during site visits and pre-sale and new home demonstrations to minimise incidents and accidents.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About Rapid Access

Rapid Access Ltd manufactures and supplies access panels and riser doors from its base in Nuneaton.

Its products go into construction and architectural projects across the UK. The business is growing, and this role joins its sales team.

The package
- £14.26 an hour, 39 hours a week
- Monday to Friday, no evenings or weekends
- No telesales or construction experience needed

The role

You'll speak to architects and contractors about upcoming projects and spot where Rapid Access products fit. When there's a real opportunity, you pass a qualified lead to sales. Success is measured against weekly and monthly lead targets.

What you'll do
- Call architects, main contractors and subcontractors using the in-house database and Glenigan
- Qualify each project: what it is, when it starts, and who makes the decisions
- Log every call and keep customer records up to date in the CRM
- Hand qualified leads to the sales team and track how they progress
- Work with sales and marketing to turn leads into real opportunities
- Hit your weekly and monthly lead generation targets

What you'll need (essential)
- Confidence making outbound calls to businesses
- Basic IT skills, including updating records on a CRM or database
- Useful, not essential
- Telemarketing, telesales or customer service experience
- Knowledge of the construction industry
- Experience using Glenigan

Benefits
- Increased pay following completion of probation.
- Monthly bonus scheme following completion of probation.
- Paid lunch fortnightly and a unique birthday bonus.
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).
- 25 days annual leave with extra holidays after five years of service.
- Annual health assessments.
- Company pension and participation in work events.
- Christmas shutdown.

Working arrangements

Location: Nuneaton, Warwickshire Fully on-site

Contract: Permanent Full-time 39 hours a week

Hours: Monday to Thursday 8:30am 5pm, Friday 8:30am 4pm

How to apply

No tsales background? That's fine. If you're confident on the phone and want to learn a specialist industry, click apply. We'll be in touch about next steps.

description:
Rugby, Warwickshire

40,000 (negotiable) + car allowance and bonus

Overview:

This large international transport and logistics business is seeking a bright, enthusiastic individual with a passion for sales to join their commercial team.

The role will have responsibility for getting out there to find new customers and re-engage with existing accounts to help grow commercial revenues in their UK & EU Road Freight division.

Access to the Coventry / Rugby area would be beneficial but the role could be done on a hybrid basis.

Responsibilities of this role:
- Own the sales journey from spotting opportunities through pitching and presenting to launching happy new customers for road freight services.
- Build a strong pipeline across the UK & EU road freight market.
- Lead customer meetings, presentations and site visits.
- Represent the business at industry events and exhibitions.
- Get to the heart of customer challenges and help to design freight and logistics solutions that work in conjunction with the Head of Sales.

The person for this role:
- Ambitious, tenacious and hungry with some pre-existing sales experience in the Freight / Logistics industry. Experience in road freight would be preferable.
- Proven experience in sales and business development and used to interacting with customers to understand their needs and develop solutions that fit.
- Excellent commercial awareness and the confidence to prospect, start new conversations and build opportunities from scratch.
- Engaging communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
- The role could suit someone looking to move from an internal sales role to a field based sales role.

title: Customer Account Manager
description:
Customer Account Manager

Stratford-upon-Avon

Hybrid Role

£26,800

About the Company:

A leading UK-based Field Services company, specialising in providing external field agency solutions primarily to the utilities sector, is seeking a Customer Account Manager/Debt Resolution Officer. With its Head Office located in Stratford-upon-Avon, the company is known for delivering excellent service with a customer-centric approach.

The Role:

The Customer Account Manager/Debt Resolution Officer will be responsible for managing customer accounts referred by clients. This position involves working with customers primarily those in arrears to find affordable and sustainable repayment solutions. The role requires exceptional communication skills to engage with customers via phone and written correspondence, ensuring timely and fair resolutions.

Key Responsibilities:
- Handle inbound and outbound calls to discuss and resolve customer accounts.
- Negotiate payment arrangements that suit customer needs and comply with company processes.
- Offer excellent customer service while collecting payments and setting up payment plans.
- Address metering issues, occupancy updates, dispute registrations, and highlight household vulnerabilities.
- Liaise with Field Representatives and Clients to ensure accurate and efficient account management.
- Maintain clear and professional account records on company and client systems.
- Identify and record any safety concerns or vulnerabilities encountered.
- Provide support and guidance to field agents during customer visits.
- Ensure adherence to industry regulations and company quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills:
- Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills (both written and verbal).
- Confidence in handling challenging conversations with professionalism and empathy.
- Previous experience in debt negotiation, collections, or customer service is desirable but not essential.
- Strong IT and accurate keyboard skills.
- Attention to detail and the ability to spot and rectify errors efficiently.
- Results-driven attitude with excellent workload management abilities.
- Experience in the utilities industry is a plus, though not required.

Why Join This Team:
- Hybrid working model offering flexibility and work-life balance.
- Supportive team environment with opportunities for professional development.
- A role where empathy and problem-solving skills make a real impact.
